summary: SiteDocument is a database entity representing documents related to a site. It includes identification fields to associate a document with a site.
purpose: To store and reference site-specific documents within the system.

entities.name: SiteDocument
entities.description: Represents a document tied to a Site.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET web page for staff administrators providing a welcome interface, recent login info, site and discipline selection, date-range filter, and a table of employment applications.
purpose: To serve as the dashboard for staff administrators, enabling them to view employment applications, filter by site/discipline/date, and access relevant data and actions.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select Site and Discipline from dropdowns (ddSite, ddDiscipline)
Filter applications: include withdrawn, refresh view

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are indicated by WithdrawnDate and special status.
Date range filters require valid start/end dates (validation applied).
Site and Discipline dropdowns include an 'All' option for broad searches.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator: StartDate and EndDate must be provided.
RegularExpressionValidator: Date fields must match valid date formats.
CustomValidator: EndDate must not precede StartDate.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if 'chkShowWithdrawn' is checked.
Show panel with login details if available.
system_behavior: GridView paginates results, allows data binding, shows empty template if no data.
JavaScript sets client-side variables for date fields.
exceptions: DataBind fails if no valid session or parameters.
Panel visibility toggled based on error/warning states.

summary: ServiceCode defines service code entities with code, description, category, and ordering used throughout the application. ServiceCodes class provides search and listing functionality for ServiceCodes by various parameters.
purpose: To represent and retrieve coded services for use in courses, timetables, and other modules.

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll procedure with session ID
Read and localize fields from database
Return list of service code objects

workflows.name: Search Service Codes by Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with parameters

business_rules: Alt language fields used if session requests alt language.
system_behavior: ServiceCode objects constructed from database rows.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records actions made to Site Profiles, including user, agency, field changes, action date, and phone. Also includes formatted representations for display.
purpose: To audit and track changes to Site Profiles by user and agency.

workflows.name: View Site Profile History
steps: User requests SiteProfileHistory for a Site
Records shown in grid with formatted details

business_rules: Display user and agency details formatted for clarity.
SysAdmin actions noted in user details.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields true, certain fields take alt value.
exceptions: If no UserSession, history retrieval is cancelled

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a data object for managing email popup documents, including identification, file name, file path, and checked status, and supports searching and deleting documents.
purpose: To handle email-related document files in popup interfaces, supporting search and deletion operations.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Split DataInfo string to extract documents
Build EmailPopupDocument objects and add to list

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Find document by ID in DataInfo

business_rules: Document deletion attempts file and folder removal; exceptions ignored.
conditions: If DataInfo provided, process documents; else return empty.
system_behavior: Search returns list of EmailPopupDocument objects.
Delete removes file and directory, reconstructs DataInfo string.
